purpose: Frozen-model external H/A/D and restart audit; no fitting, tuning or submission changes
split_status: Excluded from fitting and parameter selection; binary live/dead results were already seen. Joint H/A/D and restart-team endpoints are new prespecified diagnostics, not a new independent dataset.
reference: Raw explicit BallStatus=0 -> D; BallStatus=1 and BallPossession=1 -> H, =2 -> A. Other cases unknown, masked. No forward fill, no labels inferred from absent possession.
degradation: Identical deterministic faults and seeds to frozen stoppage validation; no new severity selection
inference: Production frozen control and stoppage functions at 25fps, separate source segments; zero Smart Tagging (unavailable externally). No reference input to prediction.
whole_match_metrics: H/A/D confusion, accuracy and macro F1 (fixed three classes, absent-class F1=0)
alive team-only accuracy before D override
false D on alive frames, wrong H/A on alive frames, missed D
event_definition: Adjacent explicit dead->alive is restart; adjacent alive->dead is stop. No boundary event across segments, unknown state or recording edges.
window_metrics: Half-open [-5,+5) second windows, clipped to segment, frame union avoids overlap double counting; separate restart and stop windows
restart_offsets: Actual H/A reference at each offset, only within same reference live run; D predictions count wrong, unknown reference excluded. Report same-owner/changed-owner/unknown strata.
restart_owner: First explicit team within first 1s of live run versus last explicit team in last 1s before preceding dead run. Never fills reference labels. Other cases unknown.
recovery: First start of a 0.4s continuously correct known H/A run in first 5s after restart, clipped at next reference stop. Report eligible, recovered, censored and latency only for recovered; no unknown frame can qualify.
transitions: Reuse frozen binary decoder's one-to-one 2s tolerance matching, plus team recovery metrics
policy: Save per-segment external predictions and reference diagnostics under ignored data; freeze hashes verified before/after. No challenge reference or video access, no new challenge candidate.
